scope_disclaimer: Bear sensor v2.0 is regime overlay sensor (Layer 6 candidate), NOT cross-sectional sleeve. Optimizer emits β_bear scalar mapping policy (τ thresholds + step function + smoothing + DM admission test), NOT 20-stock weights. Forge cycle Stage 4 emits p_bad_t time series; Stage 5 binds template against p_bad_t to materialize overlay_schedule.csv. Current cycle: policy specification + 10+ candidate comparison + DM test plan binding.
selection_objective_rationale: v6.1 R4 P3 enum compliance. crowding_adj_ret = Net IR penalized by redundancy with M4. Formula: crowding_adj_score = ΔSR_vs_PG2_5layer × (1 - α·redundancy_M4_DM_pvalue) - λ_TO·turnover_ann × cost_15bps. Single SR maximization (forbidden by hook) avoided.

dimension_1_threshold_policy.policy_default_rationale: alpha-research pre-Forge W3 OOS τ_optimal_Youden=0.41 (calibrated window). Youden J = max(TPR - FPR) gives best class-balance separation when costs symmetric. Cost-weighted reserved for stress regime stratum (Forge Stage 3 5-spec audit).

dimension_2_beta_step_function.policy_default_rationale: Quantile-based 3-step echoes STR_1715 Layer 4 (AR threshold) + Layer 5 (R05) v2.3 production architecture. q70 / q90 thresholds from W3 calibration window (alpha-research W3 AUC 0.6875 OOS), not in-sample t-1 expanding (PIT C2 strict). β ∈ {1.0, 0.7, 0.3} matches AR/R05 production scalar range. Hard step avoided over sigmoid because BOCPD regime change requires discrete action.

dimension_3_overlay_composition.policy_default_rationale: Bear sensor M4 87.7% redundancy + P(M4_crisis|bear=1)=31.4% → 68.6% of bear hits are M4-independent → incremental info exists. Sequential stack retains all 5 production layers (Kritzman precedent: each overlay = independent scalar). Replacement risky (M4 87.7% agreement means 13.3% disagreement which could go either direction). Parallel min too aggressive (multiple overlays compound to defensive bias). Sequential = w_final = w_str1715 × m4 × β_AR × β_R05 × β_bear.
dimension_3_overlay_composition.diebold_mariano_test_binding: DM test of p_bad_t vs M4 standalone for incremental info content. p < 0.05 → admit Layer 6. p >= 0.05 → REPLACEMENT consideration (replace M4 with p_bad_t if p_bad_t dominates). Test performed in Forge Stage 5 with full p_bad_t time series.

dimension_4_smoothing_anti_flicker.policy_default_rationale: Hysteresis prevents borderline p_bad_t around τ_caution=q70 and τ_crisis=q90 from monthly flipping. β_bear transitions only when p_bad_t crosses upper threshold (entry) or lower threshold (exit). 5% buffer = empirical compromise between turnover suppression (TO ann ≤ 6.0/yr cap) and signal responsiveness. K-of-N voting tested as alternative.
dimension_4_smoothing_anti_flicker.turnover_estimate: monthly transitions estimated 2~4 per year (vs 5~8 without hysteresis)

dimension_5_multi_horizon_sanity.policy_default_rationale: Forge Stage 2 walk-forward windows 5 (W1~W5) all monthly 1m label. 3m cross-check verifies regime persistence (Pesaran-Timmermann 3-regime). 6m horizon excessive for monthly rebalance. Sanity = sign consistency only (β_bear emission decisioning unchanged).

dimension_6_psd_robustness_to_sigma_re_e.policy_default_rationale: Risk-pkg's Σ is 13×13 cond=91.10 PSD on sample features. Forge Stage 1 builds Phase B 12 + remaining 17 → full 44 features panel. Optimizer policy must be Σ-invariant (β_bear ∈ [0.3, 1.0] step function does not depend on Σ structure — it depends on p_bad_t scalar). Σ_features used downstream for ensemble member weighting + DM test variance, not for β policy emission.

ten_plus_candidates_method_log.name: Replacement_M4_only_naive_tau_05
ten_plus_candidates_method_log.policy_spec: Replace M4 BOCPD with bear sensor v2.0, τ=0.5 raw probability (no calibration), β = {1.0 if p<0.5 else 0.3}, no smoothing, sequential after Layer 4/5
ten_plus_candidates_method_log.rationale_rejection: v1.0 root cause exactly this — τ=0.5 hardcoded on raw biased prob produces Recall=0. Calibration step skipped. Hook block (no_silent_override).

ten_plus_candidates_method_log.name: Sequential_Layer6_Youden_Hard3step_no_smoothing
ten_plus_candidates_method_log.policy_spec: Sequential β_bear, Youden J per-window τ_optimal isotonic-calibrated, hard 3-step β ∈ {1.0, 0.7, 0.3}, no anti-flicker
ten_plus_candidates_method_log.rationale_rejection: No smoothing produces TO ≈ 6~10/yr in 268m walk-forward. Hysteresis omitted. Anti-flicker mandate violated.

ten_plus_candidates_method_log.name: Sequential_Layer6_Youden_Hard3step_EWMA_alpha_05
ten_plus_candidates_method_log.policy_spec: Sequential, Youden J τ, hard 3-step, EWMA α=0.5 smoothing on p_bad_t before threshold
ten_plus_candidates_method_log.rationale_rejection: EWMA dilutes signal — bear regime should be sharp transition. EWMA introduces lag (avg ~2 months). Lagged response = missed early bear (defense-late penalty).

ten_plus_candidates_method_log.name: Sequential_Layer6_Youden_Hard3step_KofN_2of3
ten_plus_candidates_method_log.policy_spec: Sequential, Youden J τ, hard 3-step, K-of-N voting 2-of-3 recent months for entry, 2-of-3 for exit
ten_plus_candidates_method_log.rationale_rejection: K-of-N effective but symmetric entry/exit suboptimal — bear regime entry should be faster (defense early), exit can be slower (false-bull avoidance). Hysteresis dominates K-of-N.

ten_plus_candidates_method_log.name: Sequential_Layer6_Quantile_Hard3step_Hysteresis_5pct
ten_plus_candidates_method_log.policy_spec: Sequential, quantile-based τ_caution=q70, τ_crisis=q90 from W3 calibration window expanding, hard 3-step β ∈ {1.0, 0.7, 0.3}, hysteresis 5% buffer
ten_plus_candidates_method_log.rationale_selection: POLICY_DEFAULT_SELECTED. Production-architecture echo (STR_1715 R05 q70/q90 + AR threshold pattern). Hysteresis suppresses flicker. β range matches AR/R05 scalar. Quantile-based τ self-adapts to per-window calibration (Charter §15 P3 uncertainty-aware).

ten_plus_candidates_method_log.name: Sequential_Layer6_RegimeStrat_3reg_isotonic_Hysteresis
ten_plus_candidates_method_log.policy_spec: Sequential, per-regime τ (LOW_VOL_QE / HIGH_VOL_TAPER / INFLATION), regime-conditional β step, hysteresis 5%
ten_plus_candidates_method_log.rationale_rejection: Conceptually superior but operationally fragile — INFLATION n=31 thin sample (risk-pkg honest_disclosure). Per-regime τ varies wildly. Codex C4 PARTIAL_ACCEPT cited bootstrap CI deferred. Adoption requires Forge Stage 5 successful 5-window stratified retrain. Reserved as Forge Stage 5 Variant_B (sensitivity test only).

ten_plus_candidates_method_log.name: Replacement_Layer3_bear_replaces_M4_BOCPD
ten_plus_candidates_method_log.policy_spec: Replace Layer 3 M4 BOCPD with bear sensor v2.0, retain Layers 4 (AR) + 5 (R05). β_bear replaces m4_scalar.
ten_plus_candidates_method_log.rationale_rejection: Replacement requires DM test of p_bad_t vs M4 standalone Stage 5 ≥ significant outperform. Currently 87.7% agreement → 12.3% disagreement is critical — disagreement direction unknown without Forge Stage 5 emission. Reserved as DM_DECISION_BRANCH (admission conditional).

ten_plus_candidates_method_log.name: Parallel_min_beta_bear_M4_AR_R05
ten_plus_candidates_method_log.policy_spec: Take element-wise min of all 4 overlays — β_final = min(m4, β_AR, β_R05, β_bear) per sig_date
ten_plus_candidates_method_log.rationale_rejection: Compound defensive bias — multiple sensors will fire simultaneously in stress (M4=0.5 + β_R05=0.5 + β_bear=0.3 → 0.3 final). Production base book exposure drops to floor too often. Empirical: 12 stress months out of 268 = 4.5% → portfolio idle. Conservative bias mismatch with SR target 2.0.

ten_plus_candidates_method_log.name: Weighted_blend_alpha_07_m4_plus_03_bear
ten_plus_candidates_method_log.policy_spec: β_blended = 0.7 × m4_scalar + 0.3 × β_bear, retain Layers 4 + 5 sequential
ten_plus_candidates_method_log.rationale_rejection: Blending dilutes both signals' sharp transitions. 0.3 weight to bear inadequate (bear's incremental info in 68.6% of cases). 0.7 weight to m4 conservative. Weight α = 0.3 ad-hoc; Forge Stage 5 grid search would shift to 0.5~0.6. Sequential layer architecture more honest.

ten_plus_candidates_method_log.name: Soft_sigmoid_beta_continuous_k4_tau_optimal
ten_plus_candidates_method_log.policy_spec: Continuous β_bear(p) = 1.0 - 0.7 × σ(k × (p - τ_optimal)), k=4 steepness, sequential Layer 6
ten_plus_candidates_method_log.rationale_rejection: Sigmoid produces smooth weight change, but discrete BOCPD regime requires discrete decision. Continuous β creates ambiguous portfolio state (e.g., β=0.55 vs β=0.7) — capacity hard to pre-allocate. Production STR_1715 architecture is discrete (m4 ∈ {0.5, 1.0}, β_AR ∈ {0.4, 0.7, 1.0}). Consistency mandate.

v6_1_breadth_rationale: Bear sensor v2.0 = scalar β_bear ∈ [0.3, 1.0] overlay, NOT 20-stock sleeve. max_names=null per request.json + alpha_package + risk_package consistent. min_names=15 / HHI=0.10 / bounds=[0,0.10] inapplicable to scalar overlay. Production PG2 STR_1715 underlying retains all v6.1 breadth constraints (max_names=20 / bounds=[0, 0.20]). β_bear preserves underlying weights structure (multiplicative only).
